dataset.name: NASA Ames PCoE Battery Data Set
dataset.acquisition: NASA custom prognostics testbed; approximately 10 Hz
dataset.experiment: Charge, discharge and impedance cycling at 24°C ambient
dataset.citation: B. Saha and K. Goebel (2007), Battery Data Set, NASA Ames Prognostics Data Repository.
dataset.limitation: Laboratory cell data, not a live production-vehicle feed and not a thermal-runaway event dataset.
